symbols.P: probability: how likely the event in brackets is, as in P(y) or P(y | x)
symbols.x: the features of one example; $x_i$ is attribute i of it
symbols.mid: given: what comes after the bar is known, as in P(y | x)
symbols.i: counts attributes, x_i; in other sections it counts classes, hypotheses or examples
symbols.h: a hypothesis: one candidate explanation or model, drawn from H
symbols.c: a class: c_k or c_i is class k or i; in the e-mail example c is also a vocabulary word
symbols.y: the class label of an example
symbols.D: the training data; in the diagnostic example, the event that the person has the disease
symbols.j: counts class values nu_j in Naive Bayes; in the text models it counts vocabulary words
symbols.n: the number of features (attributes) of an example, as in the slides
symbols.sum: add up the term that follows, once for every value of the index shown
symbols.nu: a possible class value: nu_j is class j, chosen from the set V
symbols.p: the tutorial's lowercase probability, as in p(x | c_k); also the number of features p (slides use n)
symbols.A: an event: something that may or may not happen, in the probability rules
symbols.theta: the word parameter of a class: the chance a word appears (Bernoulli) or a random word is this word (multinomial)
symbols.M: just a letter in the labels MAP and ML, not a quantity
symbols.arg: the input value that gives the result which follows, used with max or min
symbols.T: transpose: turns a column vector into a row, as in (x - mu)^T; in the diagnostic example, a positive test
symbols.k: counts classes: class number k, as in c_k or C_k; in the text models, the vocabulary word number
symbols.a: the slope in y = ax + b; in the e-mail example, the vocabulary word a
symbols.max: the largest of the values that follow; with arg, the choice that gives it
symbols.sigma: the standard deviation of a Gaussian: how spread out the values are
symbols.B: an event in the probability rules; in NB and Bayes, just a letter
symbols.alpha: the smoothing constant: how many pretend counts get added; in loss formulas, an action alpha_i
symbols.prod: multiply the term that follows, once for every value of the index shown
symbols.mu: the mean (typical value) of a Gaussian; in LDA and QDA, the mean vector of a class
symbols.b: the intercept in y = ax + b; in the e-mail example, the vocabulary word b
symbols.e: Euler's number, about 2.718, in the Gaussian formulas; in the e-mail example, a stop word or an e-mail label
symbols.Sigma: the covariance matrix: each feature's spread, and how pairs of features vary together
symbols.in: is an element of: belongs to the set that follows
symbols.H: the hypothesis space: the set of all candidate hypotheses
symbols.V: the set of possible class values; in the text models, the vocabulary of words
symbols.hat:P: an estimate of the probability, worked out from training counts
symbols.m: the number of training examples (slides); as a subscript on x_m it is a word position
symbols.L: just a letter in the label ML (maximum likelihood), not a quantity
symbols.f: the true real-valued target function; in the Gaussian formula, the density f(x)
symbols.d: the number of features in the lab's formulas; in the e-mail example, a stop word
symbols.C: a class, C_i; in the LDA and QDA scores, a constant that does not change the winner
symbols.abs: the size of a set, such as the vocabulary; around a matrix, its determinant; else absolute value
symbols.w:error: the mistake: P(error) is the chance of a wrong classification
symbols.N: the normal (Gaussian) distribution N(mean, variance); in the lab, the number of training points
symbols.R: the risk (expected loss) of taking an action
symbols.pi: the constant 3.14159, in the Gaussian formula
symbols.l: the event that the e-mail contains the word lottery
symbols.w:viagra: the event that the e-mail contains the word Viagra
symbols.w:cancer: the hypothesis that the patient has cancer
symbols.propto: is proportional to: equal up to a constant factor
symbols.w:lottery: the event that the e-mail contains the word lottery
symbols.lambda: the loss: the cost of taking action alpha_i when hypothesis h is true
symbols.E: expected value: the average over the possibilities; in E[error], the expected error
symbols.varepsilon: the random noise added to the true value of example i
symbols.v: one particular value: of an attribute, or of the Viagra variable
symbols.hat:p: the estimated chance that a document of the class contains the word
symbols.w:not cancer: the hypothesis that the patient does not have cancer
symbols.min: the smallest of the values that follow; with arg, the choice that gives it
symbols.w:no: the class no (do not play tennis)
symbols.w:count: how many training rows have the stated value and class
symbols.sim: is distributed as: the variable on the left follows the distribution on the right
symbols.X: the yes/no variable for whether vocabulary word i occurs in the document
symbols.w: a vocabulary word: x_i = w_k means the word at position i is word k
symbols.w:words in class: the total number of word occurrences in documents of the class
symbols.Y: the class variable of an e-mail: spam or ham
symbols.w:predict cancer: the action of predicting that the patient has cancer
symbols.w:predict not cancer: the action of predicting that the patient has no cancer
symbols.w:prediction: the class the Bayes optimal classifier predicts
symbols.w:class: the class being scored: class one or class two
symbols.w:number of values of attribute: how many different values this attribute can take
symbols.w:overcast: the outlook value overcast in the PlayTennis data
symbols.cal:N: the normal (Gaussian) distribution, here with mean mu_i and covariance Sigma
symbols.w:posterior odds: how much we favour spam over ham after seeing the evidence
symbols.w:likelihood ratio: how many times better the evidence fits spam than ham
symbols.w:prior odds: how much we favour spam over ham before seeing the evidence
symbols.bar:D: the event that the person does not have the disease
symbols.w:documents of class: the number of training documents in the class
symbols.w:with word: that also contain the word being counted
symbols.w:documents in class: the number of training documents in the class
symbols.hat:theta: the estimated, smoothed chance that a random word of the class is word j
symbols.w:times word: how many times a word occurs
symbols.w:appears in class: in the documents of the class
symbols.w:values: the number of different values the attribute can take
symbols.w:docs with word: the number of training documents of the class that contain the word
symbols.w:docs in class: the number of training documents in the class
symbols.w:word count: how many times the word occurs in the class's documents
